sources.title: Beijing International Information Port No6 supervision procurement candidates
sources.summary: Official supervision procurement candidate notice confirms a live No6/C18 data-center development proposal inside China Mobile International Information Port. Procurement supports announced status.
sources.date_semantics: September 1 is the explicit start of candidate public notice, following August 28 bid evaluation. Future service schedule September 1, 2026 to July 23, 2028 is not an observation of physical construction.

sources.title: Beijing China Mobile International Information Port No6 project registration
sources.summary: Registration identifies No6/C18 within International Information Port, two data-center buildings, two power-center buildings and basement, with total planned floor area about 99,300 sqm.
sources.date_semantics: July 9 project registration is historical identity and planned-scope context. Company internal project approvals do not establish government planning or construction permission.

sources.title: Beijing No6 design procurement plan correction
sources.summary: Earlier official design notice places C18 southeast within Information Port; July and September notices place it northeast. Both identify No6/C18 at the same named Changping campus.
sources.date_semantics: Earlier design procurement notice. Retained to expose the unresolved cardinal-direction conflict; it is not a status refresh.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap named China Mobile International Information Port Phase3 area, way 768393624
sources.summary: Named community-mapped Phase3 polygon supplies a representative point within the wider China Mobile International Information Port campus. The locator is not No6/C18 geometry.
sources.coordinate_crs: WGS84 longitude/latitude as provided by OpenStreetMap API
sources.date_semantics: OSM version timestamp is a mapping edit date, not a construction or operation observation. Retrieval does not refresh physical status.

sources.title: China Mobile JOY contact address at International Information Port Phase3
sources.summary: Operator contact page names International Information Port Phase3, G32 building, Manbai Road, Shahe, Changping, Beijing, independently corroborating the named mapped campus sector.
sources.date_semantics: Undated contact address used for campus identity only; it establishes no No6 building or lifecycle stage.
